description: Returns the legal hourly minimum wage that applies at a US location on a date: the highest of the federal, state, county and city rates, which jurisdiction sets it, the minimum cash wage for tipped workers, special industry rates (for example California fast food, Los Angeles hotels), the next scheduled change, and the primary government source for each figure. Give an address (most accurate: it resolves the exact city and county, including unincorporated areas) or a state plus city and/or county. Rates can depend on employer size or region; pass employer_size to get one answer, otherwise every variant is listed. Free.

address.description: US street address, for example "100 N Main St, Los Angeles, CA". Resolved with the US Census Bureau geocoder.

annual_revenue.description: Employer annual gross sales or receipts in US dollars. A few states (Ohio, Oklahoma, Montana) set a lower rate below a threshold. Optional.

county.description: County name, for example "Montgomery County". Optional.

date.description: Date the work is done, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. Future dates use rates already scheduled or announced.

employer_size.description: Number of employees. Some places set different rates by employer size. Optional.

industry.description: Optional, for example "fast food", "hotel", "healthcare". Used to flag special industry rates.

state.description: Two-letter state code or name. Needed when no address is given.

name: get_minimum_wage
